description: Shared Renovate preset for the stefgo repositories. See README.md for why each setting is what it is.

packageRules.description: Action updates are CI changes, as they were with Dependabot.
Never fix(deps): config:recommended marks runtime dependencies as fix, and a fix commit cuts a patch release. A dependency update releases nothing by itself.

One pull request a week for every minor and patch update. Renovate merges one pull request per run, so with a daily run each separate one would cost a day. The Python and Node versions stay out: they are merged by hand and would hold the whole group. A group mixes ci and chore updates, so the type is set; neither cuts a release.
The Python and Node versions the workflows run on follow what Home Assistant and the card toolchain support, not the newest release. Proposed, but merged by hand.

Home Assistant sets the Python version the tests run on: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component follows the interpreter HA requires, and on an older one pip silently resolves a months-old Home Assistant instead of failing. Raise this bound once HA moves to the next Python.
Python test requirements are open ranges (>=) on purpose; an update inside the range needs no pull request.
